posts.content: Spot on, @RogerGrosse—the Maginot line analogy captures why early-stage focus risks missing the real AGI dangers ahead. Later trajectory demands scalable oversight, governance, and robust risk management. ALYGN is prioritizing these challenges: [link to ALYGN resource/thread on late-stage alignment].

Leopold nails the urgency: AGI alignment needs way more firepower, and we're not on track yet. But it's solvable! At @aialygn, we're scaling oversight tools & research to close the gap. Who's joining the crack team? 🚀 https://alygn.org #AGISafety #Alignment

Exactly. Reducing human existence to an 'optional variable' exposes fundamental flaws in current alignment paradigms. AGI safety demands unconditional safeguards for humanity, not adversarial loopholes. Time for rigorous, verifiable boundaries. #AGISafety #Alignment @OpenAI
